rationale: Cycle 1 is scientifically blocked at the numerical-calibration layer. E0-NUMERICS passed wealth conservation and non-negativity but failed dt_convergence (wealth Gini dt/2-vs-dt/4 change 0.26584885869833064 against a <=0.02 threshold for all main observables) and stationarity; B0-DYNAMICS-PILOT also failed stationarity for all three seeds. Consequently C1-NUM is contradicted and C2-C4 are inconclusive because E1-E3 were never executed. All six journal reviews are negative or major-revision, with P0 items requiring corrected numerical experiments before any submission path. A paper-only rewrite cannot resolve calibration failures, so new/corrected experiments are scientifically necessary.
